window.title: {app} – Settings
window.tagline: Your windows. One keystroke. Another screen.
window.ready: Ready. Actions move application windows between your monitors.
window.close_hint: Closing keeps {app} running in the notification area.
monitors.intro: Choose a monitor pair or rotate all windows through your monitors. Desktop, taskbar and display settings stay untouched.
monitors.column.name: Model / name
monitors.note: Numbers only apply to this overview. Saved actions use device identities.
monitors.session_only: This session only – reassign after restart
actions.intro: Global hotkeys work even while the settings are hidden. The last swap can be undone safely.
general.close_to_tray: Keep running in the tray when closed
general.tray_hint: Show a hint the first time the window is closed
general.mode.proportional: Scale proportionally to the work area
general.snap_note: Detected screen halves, quarters and thirds are split the same way on the target monitor.
general.exclusions: Excluded applications (EXE name or full path, one per line):

editor.name: Name
editor.fixed_order: Use a fixed order (drag or Up/Down)
editor.hotkey_tooltip: Press a combination. Use the clear button to save without a hotkey.
editor.hotkey_note:
Ctrl/Alt/Shift + key. Windows combinations and F12 are reserved.
The global registration is checked when saving.
editor.error.fixed_cycle: Select at least two monitors for the fixed cycle.
tray.hint_body: Use the icon in the notification area to open the settings or to quit {app}.
status.quitting: Finishing the current swap, then quitting …
status.autostart_stale: The autostart path is missing or outdated. Save the General settings again to confirm it.
status.delete_failed: The action could not be deleted: {error}
status.native_failed: Windows action failed: {error}. Details are in the log.
config.corrupt_backup: Damaged settings were backed up as {name}.
config.future_schema: The settings were written by a newer version of {app}.
hotkey.error.unsupported: Choose at least Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Windows plus a supported key (F12 is reserved).
hotkey.error.reserved: This combination is reserved by Windows. Please choose another one.
hotkey.error.in_use: This combination is already used by another action.
hotkey.error.register_failed: Windows could not register the hotkey. It may already be in use.
planner.ambiguous_identity: Monitor identity is ambiguous; please reassign
planner.two_monitors: At least two active monitors are required
planner.pair_unassigned: Monitor not assigned; please edit the pair
planner.cycle_invalid: The cycle contains missing or duplicate monitors; please reassign
engine.busy: A window swap is already running.
engine.layout_changed: The monitor layout changed during the swap. The rest was cancelled.
engine.move_failed: A window could not be moved (permissions or application behavior).
engine.window_gone: A window no longer exists or could not be checked.
engine.move_ignored: A window did not accept the move.
engine.self_changed: A window changed its target or state by itself; Undo is available.
engine.tile_not_kept: A window could not keep the intended split (e.g. minimum size or its own resizing).
engine.geometry_not_kept: A window could not keep the intended size or position; Undo is available.
engine.restore_failed: A window could not be restored.
engine.restore_incomplete: A window could not be restored completely.
